decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on mango mousse was publicly promoted, which strongly ties management's reputation to it and fits Söbbeke's organic dairy direction.
The 'Abendbrotkäse' was featured prominently on the home page as a new launch, so it is a visible commitment, and any weak early sales can be attributed to the launch phase.
The semi-hard cheese wheel received only a low-key mention, but it was part of the new cheese range the firm invested in and is too early to judge.
The spicy cheese has limited public commitment, yet it belongs to the announced cheese range expansion, and disappointing results would still be read as temporary.
The 'Monsieur Jean Bernard' soft cheese was explicitly announced as rounding off the new range, so it is a visible and justified commitment worth persisting with.
The washed-rind soft cheese is part of the same soft cheese line investment, and dropping it after one year would undercut the earlier range decision.
